scope: All VBA source modules under src, including WIP; tests and templates excluded.
method: Source annotations, reachable Git history and merged PR provenance. Codex/T3 branch names and explicit AI co-authors establish involvement, not scrutiny. No style-based detection. Targeted read-only inspection of local Cursor history established a GPT-5 stdShell refactor dated 2025-09-20; private transcripts are not published. Reviewed the supplied index of 43 local Codex session logs; stdJSON and stdEnumerator implementation/commit records replace their previous date-only estimates. Excluded disclosure work itself as evidence and did not attribute unmerged experiments to current master.
policy: Maintainer reports early Copilot/Cursor adoption, Cursor-era AI:W, and GPT-6.1 Sol-era AI:X in approximately the last five to six months. Explicit attribution and PR provenance take precedence; recent date-based assignments are estimates. Unmarked modules need provenance confirmation.
